units.source_text: 这位小姐异常孤独，即使略微相助的人也没有。

en.t: This lady was extraordinarily lonely, and there was not even anyone who could offer her the slightest help.

units.source_text: 只有她的哥哥，是个禅师，难得从醍醐来到京都时，还乘便到这宫邸里来望望她。

en.t: Only her elder brother, a Zen priest, would stop by this mansion to see her when he rarely came from Daigo to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 然而这禅师是个世间少有的守旧派。

en.t: However, this Zen priest was an unusually old-fashioned man, rare in the world.

units.source_text: 僧人固然大都是清贫的，但他这位法师穷得全无依靠，竟是一个脱离尘世的仙人。

en.t: Monks are generally poor and pure, to be sure, but this priest was so destitute and unsupported that he was almost a hermit removed from the mortal world.

units.source_text: 所以他来宫邸访问时，看见庭中杂草滋蔓，蓬蒿丛生，亦毫不介意。

en.t: Therefore, when he came to visit the mansion, he was not at all concerned to see weeds spreading through the garden and mugwort growing in tangled clumps.

units.source_text: 因此之故，这宫邸里的杂草异常繁茂，埋没了整个庭院。

en.t: For this reason, the weeds in the mansion grew with extraordinary luxuriance and buried the entire garden.

units.source_text: 蓬蒿到处乱生，欲与屋檐争高。

en.t: Mugwort and wormwood grew wildly everywhere, as if trying to rival the eaves in height.

units.source_text: 那些猪秧秧长得极密，封锁了东西两头的门，门户倒很谨严。

en.t: The cleavers grew so thickly that they sealed off the gates at both the eastern and western ends, making the entrances seem very securely guarded.

units.source_text: 然而四周围墙处处坍塌，牛马都可取路而入。

en.t: Yet the surrounding walls had collapsed in many places, so even cattle and horses could find a way in.

units.source_text: 每逢春夏，牧童竟然驱牲口进来放牧，真是太放肆了！

en.t: Whenever spring or summer came, herdboys actually drove livestock inside to graze, which was truly outrageous.

units.source_text: 有一年八月里，秋风特别厉害，把走廊都吹倒。

en.t: One year in the eighth month, the autumn winds were especially fierce and even blew down the corridors.

units.source_text: 仆役所住的板顶旁屋，都被吹得仅存房架。

en.t: The board-roofed side buildings where the servants lived were all blown apart until only their frames remained.

units.source_text: 仆役无处容身，都走散了。

en.t: The servants had nowhere to shelter and all scattered away.

units.source_text: 有时炊烟断绝，炉灶尘生。

en.t: At times the cooking smoke ceased entirely, and dust gathered on the hearth and stove.

units.source_text: 可悲可怜之事，多不胜数。

en.t: There were more sad and pitiful things than could be counted.

units.source_text: 那些凶暴的盗贼，望见这宅院荒凉沉寂，料想里面都是无用之物，因此过门不入。

en.t: Even violent thieves, seeing how desolate and silent the residence was, assumed that everything inside was worthless and passed the gate without entering.

units.source_text: 虽然如同荒山野外，正厅里的陈设布置还是同从前一样，毫无变更。

en.t: Although it was like a deserted mountain wilderness, the furnishings and arrangements in the main hall remained just as they had been before, without the slightest change.

units.source_text: 只是无人打扫，到处灰尘堆积。

en.t: It was only that no one cleaned, and dust had piled up everywhere.

units.source_text: 但大致看来，也是一所秩序井然的住屋。

en.t: But viewed overall, it was still a dwelling kept in orderly arrangement.

units.source_text: 末摘花就住在这里独数晨夕。

en.t: Suetsumuhana lived here, counting the mornings and evenings alone.
